newsitem.title: USA: Citrix Systems faces class action lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Citrix Systems faces class action lawsuit.

text.p: A lawsuit seeking class action status has been filed against Citrix Systems Inc and certain of its officers and directors, lawyers for the plaintiffs said Monday.

The complaint, filed in a federal court in Florida, alleges that the defendants violated federal securities laws by, among other things, misrepresenting or ommiting material information or both concerning the company's relationship with "a certain strategic partner." Lawyers representing the plaintiffs, Stull, Stull & Brody, said the suit was filed on behalf of buyers of Citrix securities from Jan 20 - Feb 26.
